businessScenarios.title: Customer service and commerce
businessScenarios.description: A proposed application pattern connects approved product and support documentation to an inference API. Business owners retain responsibility for response review and customer communication; no live deployment or customer outcome is claimed here.

businessScenarios.title: Enterprise knowledge retrieval
businessScenarios.description: A proposed retrieval pattern limits searches to documents a user is authorized to access and returns source context alongside generated responses. Data ownership, access permissions and retention require agreement before integration.

businessScenarios.title: Workflow and application integration
businessScenarios.description: A proposed integration pattern assists routine internal tasks. Tool actions and business decisions remain subject to explicit permissions and human approval. Workload scope, provider terms and data handling require review before production access.

deploymentPlan.title: Document the actual destination
deploymentPlan.description: Deployment destinations are documented by operator, country, region and physical site.

deploymentPlan.title: Verify facility qualifications
deploymentPlan.description: Facility documentation covers tier, physical access, power, connectivity and operating responsibility.

deploymentPlan.title: Define the permitted workload
deploymentPlan.description: Each deployment records hardware ownership, administrators, end users, end uses, remote-access locations and model workloads.

deploymentPlan.title: Approve before production
deploymentPlan.description: Production operations include implementation checks, access review, monitoring and support responsibilities.

pricingModels.description: Indicative metering by input/output tokens, requests or compute consumption. Model and provider pricing require a service order.

pricingModels.title: Capacity planning
pricingModels.description: A proposed reserved-capacity arrangement depends on accepted infrastructure, workload sizing and a written capacity commitment.

pricingModels.title: Integration and support
pricingModels.description: Architecture, knowledge integration, workflow setup and support can be scoped as a project with defined deliverables and acceptance criteria.

enterprise-service.title: Enterprise Services
paragraphs: The service designs cover model API integration, knowledge retrieval and workflow assistance. Product names describe intended service architecture, not a guarantee that every feature is generally available.

A proposed enterprise engagement starts with workload requirements, provider selection, data permissions and an integration scope. Availability, prices, acceptance criteria and support are established in a written service order.

security-governance.title: Security and Governance
paragraphs: The proposed operating framework requires defined access roles, credential protection, workload logging, data handling, incident ownership and review of users and uses before production admission.

Hardware procurement and remote access must be reviewed against applicable export controls and sanctions by qualified compliance personnel. Actual owners, affiliates, destinations and end users must be disclosed accurately.
No independent security certification or completed compliance audit is claimed. Deployment-specific evidence and written commitments must be reviewed separately.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This policy describes the corporate website operated by XMax AI Inc. at ai.xmax.com. It covers website visits and business enquiries. Processing inside a separate inference platform, customer deployment or vendor service is governed by its own notice and contract.

sections.heading: Information and purposes
sections.body: A business enquiry may include a name, company, email address and message content. Hosting and delivery systems may process network and diagnostic information such as IP address, browser details, requested pages, timestamps and error records. Information is handled to respond to enquiries, operate and protect the website, investigate technical issues and meet applicable recordkeeping requirements.

sections.heading: Recipients, retention and safeguards
sections.body: Information may be handled by authorized personnel, email and hosting providers, professional advisers or group personnel assisting with the relevant enquiry. Records should be retained only for the business purpose, legal obligations and security needs for which they are collected. Safeguards must be appropriate to the information and its use.

sections.heading: Rights and updates
sections.body: Privacy requests for access, correction, deletion, retention or processing should be sent to the legal contact shown on the Contact page. The approved effective date identifies the current version; material changes to collection, recipients or purposes require an updated notice.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: These terms address use of the corporate website of XMax AI Inc. They do not create a subscription, sale, service order or GPU procurement agreement. Paid inference services, support and deployment obligations require a separate written agreement.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use the website only for lawful information and business enquiries. Do not attempt unauthorized access, interfere with the website, distribute malicious code, impersonate another party or infringe the rights of others.

sections.heading: Product and commercial descriptions
sections.body: Service designs, product names, pricing illustrations and deployment plans are informational. Availability, model access, regions, fees and acceptance criteria are confirmed in a written service order. A planning statement is not a representation of an operational facility or binding delivery commitment.

sections.heading: Export controls and sanctions
sections.body: Transactions, hardware destinations, end users, end uses and remote access must comply with applicable export-control and sanctions requirements. Parties must supply accurate ownership, affiliation and use information for review. Nothing on this website grants a licence or states that government approval has been obtained.

sections.heading: External links and changes
sections.body: External links are provided for source verification or convenience and are governed by their own terms. These website terms may be updated with an approved effective date. A separate executed agreement governs its own governing-law and dispute-resolution provisions.
